info.name: List polls <Badge intent="info" minimal outlined>OAuth Scope: polls:read</Badge>

params.name: publicationId
params.description: The prefixed ID of the publication object

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. The limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

params.name: cursor
params.description: **Cursor-based pagination (recommended)**: Use this opaque cursor token to fetch the next page of results. When provided, pagination will use cursor-based method which is more efficient and consistent than offset-based pagination.

params.name: page
params.description: **Offset-based pagination (deprecated)**: Page number for offset-based pagination. Please migrate to cursor-based pagination using the `cursor` parameter. If not specified, results 1-10 from page 1 will be returned.

params.name: order_by
params.description:
The field that the results are sorted by. Defaults to created.
`created` - The time the poll was created.
`name` - The name of the poll.

params.name: direction
params.description:
The direction that the results are sorted in. Defaults to asc.
`asc` - Ascending, sorts from smallest to largest.
`desc` - Descending, sorts from largest to smallest.

params.name: expand[]
params.description:
Optionally expand the response to include additional data.
`stats` - Returns aggregate vote counts per choice and total completions.
`poll_responses` - Returns up to 10 most recent subscriber responses. Use /polls/{pollId}/responses for paginated access to all responses.
`trivia_answer` - Returns the correct answer for trivia-type polls.

params.name: post_id
params.description: Filter to only return polls that were embedded in the specified post. Accepts a prefixed post ID (e.g. `post_abc123`).

items.docs: Retrieve all polls belonging to a specific publication. Poll choices are always included. Use `expand[]=stats` to include aggregate vote counts per choice.
